What a bite does

Coagulopathy, internal bleeding, kidney failure develop over hours to days; can still be rapidly fatal with a large envenomation.

Antivenom source. India.

If you are bitten

Get to a hospital that holds antivenom. Keep still, remove rings and watches, and do not cut, suck or tie off the bite. Use the red “Bitten?” button at the top of any page.
